turtlecorpReview.tagline: Media review platform (video, stills, 360° panoramas): custom player, spatial comments, versions and a validation workflow.
turtlecorpReview.description: Turtlecorp Review is a full-stack workspace for organizations: annotated playback, comments anchored in time or on the image, versions, validation statuses and public sharing. The Next.js / React / HeroUI front is the studio; the NestJS / PostgreSQL API handles multi-tenancy, JWT auth, the media pipeline (Sharp, 360° detection) and Socket.IO notifications.
features: Production auth: login, activation, reset, org invites, JWT access/refresh
Multi-tenant workspaces: organizations → projects → versioned videos / images
Video review: custom player, marker timeline, threads, reactions, shortcuts
Image review: 2D pins (x/y) and a 360° viewer (yaw/pitch) with hotspots
IN_REVIEW / VALIDATED / REJECTED workflow, versions and uploads (up to 10 GB)
Realtime Socket.IO notifications and Spotlight-style ⌘K search
Public share links to view and comment without an account
Admin & KPIs: users, orgs, volumes, media in review, unprocessed comments
standout: Frame.io-style UX: annotation lives in the media, not a generic thread
Dual viewer: classic stills + 360° panoramas (Photo Sphere Viewer)
Auto equirectangular detection (ratio + EXIF/XMP: Insta360, Theta, GoPro Max)
RTK Query auth/cache on the front, JWT / role / membership guards on the API
Sentry observability, Brevo emails, CI lint / typecheck / tests / build

taskTimeTracker.tagline: VS Code extension to track time spent on tasks, straight from your Git branches.
taskTimeTracker.description: Task Time Tracker automatically picks up ticket IDs from branch names (Jira, GitHub Issues, Linear…) and measures time with precision. Pause and resume on every branch switch, configurable work hours and days off, live tracking. Monthly export to XLSX, ODS or CSV. FR/EN UI, workspace or user storage.
features: Auto ticket detection from Git branches (configurable prefixes)
Works with Jira, GitHub Issues, Linear or any URL-based tracker
Precise time (days, hours, minutes) with configurable increments
Auto pause / resume when switching branches
Work hours, 12h/24h format and days off
Panel in Source Control, collapsible monthly tracking
Spreadsheet export XLSX / ODS / CSV, optional auto-open
i18n FR / EN, workspace or user storage, one-click migration
standout: Lives in the Git / Source Control workflow, not a separate timer
Smart session merging to avoid double-counting
Month-ready reporting: ticket, author, time, status
Published on the VS Code Marketplace

glucoscan.tagline: iOS/Android app to count carbs every day: barcode scan, label OCR, meals and recipes — fully offline, no account.
glucoscan.description: GlucoScan helps people who track their blood sugar know how many carbs they eat, without retyping labels by hand. Scan a barcode (Open Food Facts), photograph a label (on-device OCR), or build a meal / recipe with raw ↔ cooked conversions. Stats (heatmap, period totals) and an iOS widget show the day's balance. Data stays local (SQLite), with import/export. Stack: Expo 56, React Native, TypeScript, WidgetKit, Zustand.
highlights: Meals, recipes and raw ↔ cooked conversion
Local data, no account, no backend
features: Product catalog: carbs/100 g, custom units, tags, photos, EAN codes
Barcode scan + Open Food Facts search (rate-limited)
On-device label OCR (ML Kit / Apple Vision) — nothing sent to the cloud
Meals: daily journal, quantities in g or units
Compositions: reusable recipes inside meals
Raw/cooked conversion (rice, pasta…) for more accurate carbs
Stats: heatmap, daily carbs, filters by period / category
iOS widget (WidgetKit + App Group): carb snapshot on the home screen
FR / EN, theme, g / oz units, tutorial, import/export
standout: Native-adjacent app: gluco-widget-bridge module, iOS App Groups, WidgetKit
Privacy: OCR and database 100% on-device, no backend
Precise domain: carbs + culinary conversion, not a generic calorie tracker
Clean architecture: features, repositories, Zustand stores, design system (atoms → templates)
